results.alsoCalled.description: Other names of a note in its result row, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

results.broader.description: Broader term of a note in its result row, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

results.cited.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {cited in # page} other {cited in # pages}}
results.cited.description: How many pages cite the note of a result row.

results.clearQuery.description: Accessible name of the button emptying the search field.

results.closestForm.description: Lead of the closest form of the dictionary proposed when a search matches nothing.

results.countersNote.defaultMessage: The counters are set when the site is published. Filtering happens in the browser, without a round trip.
results.countersNote.description: Note under the facets of the results page.

results.noResultFor.description: Notice shown when a search with words matches nothing, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

results.noteless.description: Label of the words without a note in the type facet of the results page and on the chip of their rows, in place of a type name.

results.notelessNote.defaultMessage: Words used but not defined appear with the others, dotted. That is how you spot what the glossary lacks.
results.notelessNote.description: Note under the list of results.

results.showNext.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Show the next one} other {Show the next #}}
results.showNext.description: Button under the results page that draws the next twenty rows, with how many the next batch holds.

results.usedIn.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Used in # document, never defined in the glossary} other {Used in # documents, never defined in the glossary}}
results.usedIn.description: Line of a result row that is a word without a note.
